stem: Which statement best expresses the main idea of the entire selection?

options.label: F
options.text: Studying ancient pages of papyrus is a challenging task that can help scientists learn about how people lived in ancient Egypt.

options.label: G
options.text: A box of papyrus scraps from ancient Egypt may have valuable writings mixed in with writings that are considered trash.

options.label: H
options.text: Scientists must understand both Greek and Latin to read the writings on papyrus that come from ancient Egypt.

options.label: J
options.text: People in ancient Egypt often wrote signs and symbols on a type of paper called papyrus using brushes or reed pens.
